review_constants: review the constants module that defines ROS joint names and mapping dictionaries for the Hello Stretch robot
summarize_constants: summarize the constants module containing ROS joint names, ROS-to-config mappings, and the relative resting position array
refactor_constants: refactor the constants module to add new ROS joint mappings or update the relative resting position values
test_constants: test that ROS_TO_CONFIG and CONFIG_TO_ROS dictionaries are consistent inverses of each other
build_constants: build a python module that imports and uses the ROS joint constants and mapping dictionaries for robot control
